### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **292** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**66** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 52 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8d13d09b0af82bea9b8df49c6db4f9bb0f2bb7a0` — the merge of head `1d1308b5c14e578fdc7a70ed1a0ad4529fab5827` into base `18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8d13d09b0af82bea9b8df49c6db4f9bb0f2bb7a0 && git checkout 8d13d09b0af82bea9b8df49c6db4f9bb0f2bb7a0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8 1d1308b5c14e578fdc7a70ed1a0ad4529fab5827 && git checkout -B drift-repro 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8 && git merge --no-ff 1d1308b5c14e578fdc7a70ed1a0ad4529fab5827

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 18ed2db1b770578bb54f6c02aa86d17cd0b229f8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review — ACCEPT

Head-sha: `1d1308b5c14e578fdc7a70ed1a0ad4529fab5827`

**席位意见：ACCEPT · 默认档，席位自审 · 2026-11-08T08:24Z**。本 PR 不碰四个契约面：`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，没有 `packages/spec/src`，也没有 governed 文本。所以按 fr（#31233，6711753758）的先例做默认档席位自审，不另起审查代理。超过 3000 行，按 Tier H 走人工合并。

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`。首行 `Part of #30512`，后面还有 `ru`、`de`、`ko` 三个语言。全文没有任何闭合关键词。
- **覆盖与前提实测：** 与 #31233 逐文件对齐，内容是 pt-BR 的两份生成包、出处表、手写 Setup 包、摘要表、注册行和内嵌映射。用 `--locales=…,fr,pt-BR` 重新抽取，两份生成包逐字节相同，另外 21 个生成文件不变。叶子数为 objects 1697、metadata forms 1263、手写 141，没有未译项。88 处与 `en` 相同的字节已在 Acceptance notes 里逐项列出（同形词、标识符、示例）。
- **抽读译文：** 席位按间隔读了 `pt-BR.ts` 和 `pt-BR.objects.generated.ts`。用的是巴西葡语（`usuário`、`arquivo`、`configurações`），导航术语前后一致：`Regras de atribuição`、`Modelos de e-mail`、`Credenciais SCIM`、`Envio de e-mail`、`Armazenamento de arquivos`。`nav_settings_*` 与 service-settings 的 hub 标题相同，由 hub-parity 测试钉住。repeater 行属性这类不允许直接照搬 `en` 的地方带上了父名（`Layout do widget`）。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `1d1308b5`）：** 36 个 success，17 个 skipped（按路径跳过），0 个失败。dev 本地跑 `dispatch-gates --ran`，68/68 退出码 0，NOT-MEASURED 为 0。
- **changeset：** `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch，`Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`，逐句与 diff 相符。`plugin-audit` 等包只动了测试，不需要条目。
- **接受的偏差：** 多出一个 `plugin-audit` 的 pt-BR 守护测试，与 fr 那个配对，已消融验证。PR 带 `tests` 标签，因为 `pr_create` 不接受空标签列表。dev 报告里 `security_findings` 写成 `withheld` 是笔误，dev 已在线程里确认为 none。
- **范围外去向：** fr 的 `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` 摘要已过期，fr 读者会回退看到英文副标题。这个修正随 `ru` 那个 PR 一起做（同卡，相邻缺陷），不在这里改。
- **落地条款：** 7434 行，超过 3000 行门槛，需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准后才能进队。批准后，席位让卡线程再合一次 `origin/main`，重跑 `check:app-nav-i18n`、hub parity 和 `platform-page-i18n-parity`，然后由席位落地（ar 和 fr 都曾因 main 新增的导航键出过队）。
